item.description: During the 2025 summer recess, the former Town Manager exercised administrative purchasing authority to award an agreement to Michael Grant Painting for the painting of Town Hall. Following the recess, the Town Commission adopted Resolution 2025‑020, which ratified all agreements executed by the former Town Manager during that period. However, the Town Hall Painting Agreement with Michael Grant Painting was not included in the list of ratified agreements, despite having been executed within the same timeframe. To ensure the Town’s records are complete and consistent with the intent of Resolution 2025‑020, staff recommends individual ratification of this agreement.
